title: Seattle, the window at night
logline: The first Seattle apartment's window at night from inside, invented: the water black, a ferry's lights crossing it, the room dark behind the glass's reflection of a lamp that isn't on.

panels.composition: An apartment window at night from inside: black water beyond with a ferry's lights crossing it, the room dark, the glass reflecting an unlit lamp.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, an apartment window at night from inside showing black water with a ferry's row of lights crossing it, a dark room reflected in the glass with an unlit lamp, no people, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: A ferry. A lamp not on.
